mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: expect clear skies with a comfortable 84 degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School under a bright full moon.

The City Clerk's office is currently hosting an I Voted sticker design contest for local students in grades K through 12. Voting is officially open online through August 7, and the winning designs will be featured on stickers used during the November 2026 election.

There is plenty to do around town, starting with trivia games at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company happening today. Tomorrow, you can look forward to the farmer's market, live music, and even more trivia at The Bogey Factory.
In the weekly police report, officers responded to a domestic disturbance on July 23 in the 400 block of Lucerne Drive, resulting in an arrest for disorderly conduct and intimidation of a victim.
You can enjoy the Georgia Peach flavor of the day at Culver's, which remains open until 10 PM. While you are out, Kona Ice will also be at Fireman's Park today from 1:30 PM to 4:15 PM.
